chunks: Whoever wishes to use nūrah, let him take some of the nūrah and place it on the tip of his nose and say: O Allah, have mercy on Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd عليه السلام, as he instructed us regarding nūrah. Then the nūrah will not burn him, if Allah, Mighty and Majestic, wills.

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; opening word of supplication
key_terms.النُّورَةِ: depilatory paste used for removing hair
key_terms.تُحْرِقُهُ: burn him or cause burning to him
key_terms.سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ دَاوُدَ: Sulaymān, son of Dāwūd عليه السلام
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an honorific for Allah
key_terms.يَتَنَوَّرَ: to apply nūrah, meaning to use depilatory paste

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be said when using nūrah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a specific du'a to be said when using nūrah (depilatory paste). It presents an etiquette of personal cleanliness combined with remembrance of Allah and mention of Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd عليه السلام.
